Hi, I'm Hannah.

I spent twelve years as a financial adviser, explaining the same things to worried people over and over. So I started writing them down, one simple email at a time.

I don't sell financial products and I never take money from banks to mention them. The Sunday Sum is paid for by readers who choose to support it.

Questions

Is The Sunday Sum really free?

Yes. The weekly email is free forever. Some readers choose to pay $5 a month to support it and get a bonus issue each month.

How often will you email me?

Once a week, every Sunday at 8am. We never send extra promotional emails.

Is this financial advice?

No. The Sunday Sum explains money news and ideas in general terms. For advice about your own situation, speak to a regulated financial adviser.

Can I unsubscribe easily?

Yes. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe link at the bottom.
